# Cameron S Humphries

> App pages for software published by Cameron S Humphries.

- Home: https://cameronhum.github.io/

## Cymatic

Cymatic is a Windows application by Cameron S Humphries. Interactive Windows cymatics and music visualiser that turns PC audio into water patterns. PC sound or a built-in tone drives the dish. A steady pitch locks the dish. Silence lets the water settle.

Capabilities: PC sound follows pitch and loudness. Built-in tone with pitch and volume. Drive, settle, wave speed, stroke, pitch follow, loudness follow, overtone, amplitude, crests, light, and ambient. Colours are Water, Ink, Gold, Iridescent, Galaxy, Aurora, Ember, and Blood. Surface is normal, low poly, wireframe, or dots. Perimeter is glass, a ring, a fade, or none. Orbit, zoom, slide, and full screen.

PC audio is used on that computer while the window is open. It is not recorded, saved, or transmitted. There is no account, no ads, and no analytics. Settings stay on the PC. Cymatic is sold on the Microsoft Store (https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n09bgpd2857) as a one-time purchase (USD $0.99); Microsoft processes the payment.

- App page: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymatic/
- Privacy: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymatic/privacy/
- Publisher: Cameron S Humphries
- System: 64-bit Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later, including Windows 11
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n09bgpd2857
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Purchase: One-time purchase through Microsoft Store
- Audio input: PC audio or built-in tone generator
- Microphone: Not required for PC audio

Cymatic is an interactive Windows cymatics and music visualiser that turns PC audio into water patterns. Unlike conventional spectrum-bar visualizers, it presents the sound as a customizable dish of water. Download: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n09bgpd2857. It supports full-screen viewing and does not require a microphone, account or subscription.

## While Ago

While Ago is a free Windows last-done and activity tracker by Cameron S Humphries. It tracks when you last did things: a time-since tracker and routine tracker with growing cards on visual workspaces. Organise habits, routines and activities, switch between canvas, list and chart views, and keep everything in private offline storage on the PC.

Key features: canvas with pan and zoom, remembered per workspace. Separate workspaces. List and chart of the same activities. Search, light and dark, and archive. A rhythm can be daily, every few days, weekly, monthly, custom, or learned from gaps you have already logged. Windows 10 and Windows 11 desktop.

There is no account and no server. The app does not show ads and does not include analytics. Times, notes, workspaces, card positions, and settings stay in localStorage on the PC, under the local app data folder for com.whileago.app. They are not uploaded.

- Canonical app page: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/
- Privacy: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/privacy/
- Support: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/support.html
- Donate: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/donate.html
- Publisher: Cameron S Humphries
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Pricing: Free on the Microsoft Store
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P3HGRVDRNG0
- Account: None required
- Storage: On the PC only (offline)
